pages.text: WHILE runs its code block as long as its condition is true.$(br2)It checks the condition before each round. If it is false right away, the code block never runs. The condition must give a BOOLEAN and ends with $(1);$().
Craft a structural base and a diorite block, or turn a REPEAT block into a WHILE block.
$(1)VARIABLE n INTEGER 3$(br)WHILE n > 0 ;$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN countdown countdown ⊕ n ⊕ " " ;$(br)  ASSIGN n n - 1 ;$(br)END WHILE$()
